author: Pallas, 1811
summary: 산지의 벼랑과 비탈, 하천 부지에 사는 새로, 한국 북부 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 겨울에는 10마리에서 수백 마리에 이르는 큰 무리로 지낸다. 화본과·여뀌과·질경이과·콩과 식물의 씨앗 등을 먹는다. 시베리아 동부 산악 지대, 쿠릴 열도 북부, 홋카이도 등지에서 번식하고, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 일본 북부와 중부, 우수리 등지에서도 겨울을 난다.

points.en: hindcrown and hindneck tipped pale brown
dark brown back feathers tipped buff
rump and belly feathers tipped rose-pink

sexes.male: 몸 대부분이 잿빛이고 허리·배·아래꼬리덮깃의 깃끝이 장미색이다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 색이 연하고, 배와 허리가 연한 푸른빛이 도는 은회색이다.

art.subject: Asian Rosy Finch (Leucosticte arctoa), adult male in winter: forehead, face and throat sooty blackish; crown dark grey; hindcrown and hindneck feathers tipped pale golden-brown, forming a paler brown nape; back dark brown with buff feather tips; rump dark brown with rose-pink tips; breast and flanks dark sooty grey, the belly and undertail coverts scaled with rose-pink feather tips; wings blackish with rose-pink edges to the coverts; tail blackish-brown, notched; bill pale yellow with a dark tip in winter; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: foraging for seeds on the ground in a flock, one bird in side view
art.scene: Korean winter mountains: rocky cliffs and slopes above a stony riverbed with dry grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view on the ground: sooty blackish face, pale brown-tipped hindcrown and nape, mostly dark grey body, dark brown back with buff tips, rose-pink tips on the rump and belly, pink-edged wing coverts, blackish-brown notched tail, yellow bill, black legs
adult female winter, side view on the ground: duller and paler grey-brown overall, with much less and fainter pink on the belly, rump and wings
art.build: Stocky finch, slightly larger than a sparrow, with a rounded head, short thick neck and long wings that reach well down the tail at rest. Bill short, conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs short, black. Tail medium length, clearly notched. Feeds on the ground in tight flocks, walking and shuffling among stones; whole flocks rise and wheel together.
avoid: Do not paint a red head or breast like a rosefinch; the pink appears only as feather tips on the belly, rump and wings.
Do not paint a dark or reddish bill on winter birds; in winter the bill is yellowish with a dark tip.
Do not make the body pale grey; it is dark sooty grey-brown with a paler brown nape.
Do not paint pink legs; they are black.
